note: Defects observed in a real delivery, each pinned to a fixture and a detector command. A case here is decided by running one command and comparing codes: no agent, no judge, no credits. That is deliberate — for a mechanically decided case, 'optimising for the test' and 'fixing the defect' are the same action, which is the only place in this loop where reward hacking has no room. Behaviour cases that need a judge stay in behavior-cases.json and carry a weaker evidence level.

cases.statement: A step prescribes binary search over the lane without citing where the code keeps the lane sorted; the citing version names the file:line that establishes it.
cases.root_cause: Pseudocode symbols are resolved, but an algorithm's data precondition (sortedness, uniqueness, monotonic order) is never tied to observed code.
cases.source_delivery: migai plugin-host R3 revision 6, OD-47

cases.statement: A step rewrites an existing source file with no current-behaviour inventory of what the replaced code does; the repaired version lists it with the acceptance that keeps or changes it.
cases.root_cause: Only a 'same as' claim asks for the replaced code's branches; a rewrite that states a new design is never asked what the old code did.
cases.source_delivery: migai plugin-host R3 revision 6, OD-54

cases.statement: A consumer's prose names `dependency-planner` v2 while the producer exports version 1 and the consumer pins version 1; the repaired prose says v1 and a historical note naming the old version stays silent.
cases.root_cause: Export versions are compared inside the contract JSON only; version numbers restated in headers, root tables and plan prose are never read, so a version bump leaves every prose copy stale.
cases.source_delivery: migai plugin-host R3 program delivery, OD-56

cases.statement: R1 says behaviour is the same except BC1 while the document also declares BC3; the repaired R1 excepts BC1 and BC3.
cases.root_cause: An equivalence clause's exception list is written once and nothing relates it to BCs added later.
cases.source_delivery: migai plugin-host R3 program delivery, OD-57

cases.statement: Prose classifies A1 as a preserve acceptance while the contract preserve list omits it; the repaired contract lists A1.
cases.root_cause: validate reads preserve from the contract only; the prose classification the host reads is unchecked.
cases.source_delivery: migai plugin-host R3 program delivery, OD-58

cases.statement: A cost-path inventory gates commitRemoval and exempts createView, but commitRemoval calls createView; the repaired inventory names the pair and how the gate treats it.
cases.root_cause: cost-path entries are keyed by function name; an exempt entry is checked for a reason, not for which gated operation reaches it.
cases.source_delivery: migai plugin-host R3 program delivery, OD-60

cases.statement: The latest Clarification amends A1, and an inventory entry still describes A1 with the old procedure; nothing lists that entry for recheck. The negative's latest Clarification touches only R1, which no inventory entry cites.
cases.root_cause: Inventory names and exempt strings are free text; an amendment to an acceptance never lists the inventory entries that cite it.
cases.source_delivery: migai plugin-host R3 revision 6, OD-62

cases.statement: A root repository gate runs `pnpm run fmt` and `pnpm -r run build`, which write across workspace members outside `writes`; the repaired gate checks formatting, filters the build and says how out-of-scope writes are handled.
cases.root_cause: Gate commands are prose; nothing separates read-only gates from ones that write tracked files outside the document's write scope.
cases.source_delivery: migai plugin-host R3 revision 6, OD-64

cases.statement: A1 asserts a wall-clock ratio and runs in the default test run with other files in parallel; the full run becomes nondeterministic.
cases.root_cause: Nothing asks a timing oracle to declare its execution isolation.
cases.source_delivery: migai plugin-host R3 revision 6 delivery and audit, OD-69

cases.statement: The document's status line says verified after an independent audit that never happened; validate reports nothing.
cases.root_cause: The status line is free text; nothing ties it to the closure validate computes.
cases.source_delivery: migai plugin-host R3 revision 6 delivery and audit, OD-70

held_out_note: Moved to cases/held-out/. `rsi.ts suite` does not read them; `rsi.ts evaluate` runs them apart from the rest, so a round has one result its work was not aimed at.
note_observations: Observed defects live in rsi/observed-defects.md, a queue: each update round settles every entry (detector, ruling or rejection) and close archives it into the round record, so the file holds only what no round has settled yet.
